nuggets.text: Ryan Silverfield's Memphis team beat the Razorbacks 32-31 in 2025; that November, Arkansas hired him.
KJ Jackson is the first left-handed Razorbacks quarterback to start a season opener since Barry Lunney Jr. in 1995.
KJ Jackson threw for 267 yards and three touchdowns in the 31-14 opening win over North Alabama.
Gavin Rush averaged 48.0 yards a punt in his first college action and made the Ray Guy Award's weekly list.
The Razorbacks were once the Cardinals; coach Hugo Bezdek said his 1909 team played like a wild band of razorback hogs.
Every Tusk, the Razorbacks' live Russian boar mascot, has come from the same family line.
Tusk VI starts his day with a mud bath and has been trained to give kisses to anyone brave enough.
The Woo, Pig! Sooie! hog call has been a Razorbacks tradition since the 1920s.
The 1964 Razorbacks went 11-0, beat Nebraska 10-7 in the Cotton Bowl and claim the FWAA national title.
